Operate a hosted erun platform's control-plane API

Usage:
  erun platform [command]

Available Commands:
  context     Manage the erun platform's own cloud contexts (managed clusters)
  env         Manage hosted environments on the erun platform
  provision   Preview the ordered plan for provisioning a hosted environment
  tenant      Manage tenants on the erun platform
  user        Manage users on the erun platform
  whoami      Show the caller's resolved identity on the erun platform

Flags:
      --erun-alias string   erun platform cloud alias to target (defaults to the sole configured erun-type alias)
  -h, --help                help for platform

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun platform [command] --help" for more information about a command.
